items.title: WHEN IT COMES TO THE BAB EL-MANDEB STRAIT, THE HOUTHIS RUN THE SHOW.
items.content:
WHEN IT COMES TO THE BAB EL-MANDEB STRAIT, THE HOUTHIS RUN THE SHOW.

 x.com/windwardai/status/2087… Windward (@WindwardAI)12 Saudi-flagged tankers and bulkers are on the same route around the Cape of Good Hope right now. None through Bab el-Mandeb.

The detour adds roughly 4,000-6,000 nautical miles and 10-14 days to a Europe or Mediterranean-bound voyage. Several of these vessels changed their stated destination more than once in the past two weeks, and some only locked one in after passing South Africa. 

A carrier rerouting its fleet around a chokepoint while keeping destinations ambiguous is a risk signal worth reading.—  https://x.com/WindwardAI/status/2087929707828273299 
— Steve Hanke (@steve_hanke) Aug 13, 2026
